title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Watermelon Ice Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Watermelon Ice delivers the classic, juicy sweetness of fresh watermelon balanced by a refreshing menthol exhale for a truly invigorating vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, offering extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Featuring advanced dual mesh coil technology, these pods provide smooth, consistent vapour and bold, refreshing flavour. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design make refilling effortless and hassle-free. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs, ensuring exceptional value and convenience. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods offer a silky-smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief, making them perfect for adult vapers seeking a refreshing and long-lasting vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the cool, fruity Watermelon Ice flavour.
